name: Jersey Airport

hours.v: Opens 07:00, closes 21:00 local in winter and 21:30 in summer, every day

curfew.v: Closed outside opening hours (winter 21:00–07:00, summer 21:30–07:00 local); movements outside hours only in extenuating circumstances and pay out-of-hours dues
curfew.quote: For each arrival and each departure outside normal opening hours,

ppr.quote: are required to check relevant NOTAM for PPR requirements.

noise.v: No engine running or APU from airport close until 06:00 local without the Airport Authority's permission
noise.quote: not permitted between normal airport close and 0600 local time

notes: UK NATS eAIP (nats-uk.ead-it.com) could not be opened in this run (proxy refused the host; WebFetch permission not granted), so no UK AIP AD 2 data was read. Read the Ports of Jersey Aerodrome Manual v7.0 (Jul 2025), noise procedure JA-AOP-006 (2022), the 2026 tariff and ACL's Jersey page. Hours are from ACL (the manual says hours are in the UK AIP). The manual's declared-distances table shows RWY 08 TORA 1705 m and RWY 26 TORA 1648 m, but the text could not be quoted word for word, so runway is listed as missing; confirm in the AIP. Out-of-hours dues are very high (the midnight–05:30 band is GBP 11,060 per movement). Customs not covered by the sources read.
